/-- Integrand for representing `x ↦ x ^ p` for `p ∈ (0,1)` -/
noncomputable def rpowIntegrand₀₁ (p t x : ℝ) : ℝ := t ^ p * (t⁻¹ - (t + x)⁻¹)

/-- `s.card` is the number of elements of `s`, aka its cardinality.

The notation `#s` can be accessed in the `Finset` locale. -/
def card (s : Finset α) : ℕ :=
  Multiset.card s.1

results.name: Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.evalFinsetCard
results.source_text:
/-- Extension for `Finset.card`. `#s` is positive if `s` is nonempty.

It calls `Mathlib.Meta.proveFinsetNonempty` to attempt proving that the finset is nonempty. -/
@[positivity Finset.card _]
meta def evalFinsetCard : PositivityExt where eval {u α} _ pα? e :=
  match pα? with | none => pure .none | some _ => do
  match u, α, e with
  | 0, ~q(ℕ), ~q(Finset.card $s) =>
    let some ps ← proveFinsetNonempty s | return .none
    assertInstancesCommute
    return .positive q(Finset.Nonempty.card_pos $ps)
  | _ => throwError "not Finset.card"
results.docstring:
Extension for `Finset.card`. `#s` is positive if `s` is nonempty.

It calls `Mathlib.Meta.proveFinsetNonempty` to attempt proving that the finset is nonempty.

results.name: Filter.map_card_atTop
results.source_text:
/-- The pushforward of `atTop` on `Finset α` along `Finset.card` is `atTop` on `ℕ`, when `α` is
infinite. -/
lemma map_card_atTop [Infinite α] :
    map (Finset.card (α := α)) atTop = atTop := by
  rw [map_atTop_eq, atTop]
  refine Function.Surjective.iInf_congr Finset.card Finset.exists_card_eq fun s ↦ congr(𝓟 $(?_))
  ext
  refine ⟨Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq _ _, ?_⟩
  aesop (add safe apply Finset.card_le_card)
results.docstring:
The pushforward of `atTop` on `Finset α` along `Finset.card` is `atTop` on `ℕ`, when `α` is
infinite.

/-- The element representing the `1` in `Fin (1 + n + n)`.
  This is then casted to `Fin (2 * n + 1)`. -/
def oddShiftZero : Fin (2 * n + 1) :=
  Fin.cast (odd_shift_eq n) (Fin.castAdd n (Fin.castAdd n 1))

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
